ROOT_CAUSE: The existing monitor awaited the 24-second eBay reader before starting database authorities without a request deadline. Serial source waves and SDK retry/backoff could extend the total beyond MCP's unchanged 30-second deadline. Orders also waited for unrelated portfolio discovery. The fix runs independent existing authorities concurrently, bounds live reads to 12 seconds and database reads to 6 seconds, and preserves their existing fail-closed partial results.
CODE_CHANGES: 18-second internal latency envelope; eBay 12 seconds (+500ms settlement guard), each eBay call at most 3500ms; database shared deadline 6000ms.
Independent database authorities and existing live authorities start concurrently; dependent supply/order-line reads retain real identity prerequisites.
One existing source capture reused in projection; no duplicate database acquisition.
Abort database transfers including response body; prevent SDK 520/network retry/backoff; no writes permitted by bounded transport.
Request-local credential read deduplication retains exact scope validation and independent authority/account binding checks.
Existing snapshot/singleflight TTL remains 300000ms; capture time, original source timestamps, cache reuse/age and explicit source failures are exposed.
Read budget/source reader telemetry only; no new authority, ledger, runtime, catalog, credentials, Product Truth semantics, or relay configuration.
NEXT_BLOCKER: seller_os_get_product_case intermittently returned HTTP 502 and exceeded the same 30-second MCP deadline during Golden comparison. The full shared-tool sweep and two subsequent paired Golden comparisons passed, but do not erase those failures. Prior recovery records also mention an initial Golden read failure. The precise server-side cause and regression attribution remain UNPROVEN; certify that read's bounded stability before relay alignment. Product Truth semantics were not changed.
